edition_identity_1658.title: 滴天髓輯要 (Ditian Sui Jiyao, 'Essentials of the Ditian Sui')
edition_identity_1658.compiler: 海昌陳之遴素庵氏輯 (Chen Zhilin, hao Su'an, of Haichang) — so printed on the first text leaf (PDF page 6)
edition_identity_1658.preface: 自序 on PDF page 2, signed 順治戊戌春二月望日素庵老人書 — Shunzhi wuxu = 1658 CE, 15th day of the 2nd spring month
edition_identity_1658.attribution_statement_in_preface: The 1658 preface opens: 滴天髓之書。乃一知命者所作。託於誠意伯劉基。— i.e. Chen Su'an himself states the base text was written by an anonymous 'knower of fate' and ATTACHED to Liu Ji's name. The Liu Ji attribution was already marked as unresolved by the earliest dated witness we hold.
edition_identity_1658.physical_print: This scan is NOT a 1658 woodblock: it is a Republican-era typeset reprint by 乾乾書社 (Qianqian Book Society, Shanghai, 靜安寺路戈登路口慶福里九號), whose catalog page (PDF page 3) advertises 子平真詮評註 and 滴天髓徵義 — both 1930s Xu Lewu-circle publications. The DATED layer is Chen Su'an's 1658 compilation and preface that the reprint transmits; the physical witness is ~1930s.
edition_identity_1658.library_marks: National Library / 國立北平圖書館 collection seal on PDF page 6; shelf marks 293.1 / 377, accession 43636 on PDF page 2; 贈品 (gift) stamp on title leaf

collation_notes: The wikisource transcription of 滴天髓闡微 is in SIMPLIFIED characters and carries OCR-grade corruption (e.g. line 2451 reads 奶之轻者也 for 根之轻者也, 根挭 for 根重, 衰右有旺 at line 2449 for 衰中有旺); verbatim quotes below reproduce the file as-is and flag corruption where load-bearing.

In the 闡微 transcription the 從象 chapter's base-text couplet is MISSING and was supplied by a later hand: line 7458 reads 孤立无气唯有从，依得财官享富贵。（原文缺，此后人按原注意补）. The canonical line 從得真者只論從，從神又有吉和凶 is therefore NOT attested in our transcription's base text; its second half is quoted inside Ren Tieqiao's commentary (line 7462: 所谓从神又有吉和凶也). The 1658 witness must arbitrate.
